stories.title: Laura and Nina meet at Michigan orientation
details: same campus tour group
Nina's chemistry questions put the group twenty minutes behind
Laura thought she was the most annoying person
same dorm floor, inseparable by October
Nina said 2009 but conceded 2008
later lived together in Chicago six years until Nina left for Denver in 2019; Laura visits every summer
stories.why_it_matters: origin of the oldest friendship at the table
stories.complication: Nina held up the tour with chemistry questions

stories.title: The kettle ramen smoke alarm
details: randomly assigned roommates
Chris made ramen in an electric kettle and set off the smoke alarm
whole building outside in the rain at 2 a.m.
Arjun decided Chris needed a friend
Chris will mention the kettle in his groomsman speech
stories.why_it_matters: origin of Chris and Arjun's friendship; running joke
stories.complication: Chris set off the smoke alarm the first night
stories.vivid_detail: building outside in the rain at 2 a.m.

stories.title: Founding the Dynasty League
details: Chris says 2014, year of his first real job
Arjun says 2013 and claims to have the email
Sam joined 2017 and won twice

stories.title: Laura and Sam Reyes
details: Sam Reyes rear-ended Laura at a stoplight
they got coffee instead of exchanging insurance
dated three years, calm breakup
now one of her best friends, visiting in April
stories.outcome: dated three years, now best friends

stories.title: Emily and Paige's Iceland ring road trip
details: tiny rental car, ten days
flat tire on day four, no cell service
old farmer on a tractor changed it, refused money
invited them in for lamb soup, best meal of Emily's life
stories.why_it_matters: Emily's signature travel story; disputed year
stories.complication: flat tire with no cell service
stories.outcome: farmer fixed it and fed them
stories.vivid_detail: lamb soup, best meal of her life

stories.title: Owen's ACL at Breckenridge
details: climbing crew ski weekend
Owen, a physical therapist, went off a tiny jump and landed flat
tore his ACL on a green run (he claimed blue, conceded)
eight months of rehab, terrible patient
Megan came twice a week to make him do exercises; he cried at the leg press
stories.why_it_matters: the group's favorite tease of Owen
stories.complication: a PT tore his ACL on a green run
stories.outcome: eight months rehab, Megan coached him
stories.vivid_detail: six-year-olds on the run; cried at the leg press

stories.title: Nina's 21st birthday party
details: Laura threw a surprise party for about forty
the landlord showed up and danced until 2 a.m. instead of shutting it down
stories.vivid_detail: danced until two in the morning

stories.title: Arjun and Claire's engagement and upcoming wedding

Claire is a pediatric dentist

Ravi is coming

stories.title: Ravi turns out to be Arjun's cousin

stories.why_it_matters: a new connection discovered between friend circles
